items.title:
ai.codriverlabs:scaleout-build-ecs 0.0.1-centraltest 发布, ECS task orchestration, S3 staging, and native-image input planning. Extracted from
        scaleout-build-maven-plugin so that both the plugin's direct-ECS backend and the
        control-plane service can launch and supervise build tasks without the service having to
        depend on the Maven plugin (and therefore on maven-plugin-api).

com.google.cloud:google-cloud-biglake-hive 0.4.0 发布, Lakehouse The Lakehouse API (formerly BigLake API) provides access to a serverless,
fully managed, and highly available metastore that provides a single
source of truth for your data lakehouse. It lets multiple
engines—including Apache Spark, Google Managed Spark, Apache Flink, Trino
and BigQuery—share tables and metadata for key open formats (Apache
Iceberg, Apache Hive), and query the same copy of data. Plus, through the
Lakehouse runtime catalog federation seamlessly unite your lakehouse
ecosystem, letting Iceberg compatible engines on Google Cloud (BigQuery,
Google Managed Spark) discover and analyze enterprise data across
Snowflake, Databricks, and AWS Glue.

io.github.shrinivas93:rest-in-peace-spring-boot-starter 1.0.0.52 发布, Spring Boot auto-configuration for REST-in-peace: auto-registers every
		@RestClient interface found on the classpath as a Spring bean, instead
		of one hand-written @Bean method per interface. See
		docs/design/spring-boot-starter.md in the parent repository for the
		full design and rollout plan. A sibling reactor module of core/ (not
		a dependent of it in the reactor sense - it resolves core the same
		way a real downstream consumer would, as an ordinary Maven
		dependency), sharing core's version and release cadence via their
		common parent. Requires Java 17+ and Spring Boot 4.x; the core
		rest-in-peace library itself stays on Java 8.
